name: Greenply Industries Ltd
about: Established in 1990, [1] Greenply Industries Limited is amongst the leading plywood manufacturers in India with a 26% share of the organized market. Greenply offers a wide range of panel products including plywood, block boards, decorative veneers, doors, and film-faced plywood, among others. [2]
keyPoints:
Product Portfolio
The Co.’s product portfolio comprises plywoods and blockboards, decorative veneers, flush doors, specialty plywood, and Polyvinyl Chloride (PVC) products. [1]

cons: Stock is trading at 4.27 times its book value
Company has a low return on equity of 11.4% over last 3 years.
Dividend payout has been low at 7.46% of profits over last 3 years
